proposal.cover_letter:
Thank you for the opportunity to walk Building A at Magnolia Professional Center. Our team looked closely at how your staff and visitors use the space, from the busy lobby entrance off the parking deck to the second-floor break room.

The plan below covers nightly cleaning five days a week, with extra attention on the lobby and on restrooms that your team restocks daily. Every area was measured and priced line by line so you can see exactly what you are paying for.

Please review the scope and the pricing summary below. We would be glad to walk the building with you again to adjust anything before you decide.
scope_of_work: Restrooms: clean and disinfect toilets, urinals, sinks and counters; restock paper and soap; mop floors nightly
Offices and open office: empty trash, dust reachable surfaces, vacuum carpet
Lobby: clean entry glass, damp mop tile, vacuum entry mats
Corridors and stairs: dust mop and damp mop hard floors, wipe handrails
Conference rooms: wipe tables, vacuum, reset chairs
Break room: clean counters, sink and appliance exteriors; mop floor
exclusions: Strip and wax and carpet extraction (quoted separately as periodic services)
